text: The why_agreed should change, not the trigger. A pullback-into-value line does not describe a prior-high break, so quoting it under this trigger misstates the camp. From my method the break is the right buy: rs_rank_pct 86.66, W HH/HL, 9>21, 2.9% under the 20-wk high, the D red bar a pause, not a break (C5, C11). I would not move it to reclaim:ma_20, which buys the dip (C9 adds on strength). I ratify h1_close_above:bar_high on volume at least 1.4x normal (C6). My reservation stays on the WATCH timing; I acted today.
